title: 8 hoa mây mới cho Sobi Cloud: 8 loài × 4 giai đoạn (mở rộng)
decisions: Expansion proposal 2026-10-16 (owner asked for more variety): 8 sky flowers beside the 6 of cloud-01-flowers, each tied to one sky element (sun, rain, thunder, snow, sunset, comet, crystal, lotus) so potions can use them. Same rules: the flower stands alone on a tiny soil mound, CloudScene draws it on plot_cloud, origin at the bottom; same 152x132 shared scale; magic shown by colour and shape only (no glow, no sparkles). Content rows (content/cloud/flowers.json), seeds, flower icons and manifest rows only after approval.

sheets.name: F5
sheets.title: Tulip Nắng + Cẩm Tú Cầu Mưa

cells.desc: Sun Tulip sprout: two smooth pointed green leaves
Sun Tulip growing: a closed golden bud on a straight stem
Sun Tulip in full bloom: three cup-shaped tulips in warm sunshine yellow fading to orange at the tips, petal tips shaped like soft sun rays
Sun Tulip wilted
Rain Hydrangea sprout with two broad serrated leaves
Rain Hydrangea growing: a leafy bush with a tight green bud cluster
Rain Hydrangea in full bloom: two round pom-pom flower clusters in rain-blue and periwinkle, each tiny petal with a little raindrop-shaped pale highlight
Rain Hydrangea wilted
Thunder Iris sprout: two sword-shaped green leaves
Thunder Iris growing: tall sword leaves and a slim closed violet bud
Thunder Iris in full bloom: two iris flowers in deep storm-violet with a zig-zag lightning-yellow stripe on each falling petal
Thunder Iris wilted
Snow Camellia sprout with two glossy dark-green oval leaves
Snow Camellia growing: a small glossy-leaved shrub with a round white bud
Snow Camellia in full bloom: three layered round camellia flowers in snow white with icy pale-blue petal edges, golden centres, glossy dark leaves
Snow Camellia wilted

sheets.name: F7
sheets.title: Dâm Bụt Hoàng Hôn + Oải Hương Sao Chổi

cells.desc: Sunset Hibiscus sprout with two toothed oval leaves
Sunset Hibiscus growing: a leafy stem with a twisted closed coral bud
Sunset Hibiscus in full bloom: two large open hibiscus flowers fading from peach-orange at the edges to deep rose-pink at the centre, a long golden stamen
Sunset Hibiscus wilted
Comet Lavender sprout: a tiny tuft of narrow grey-green leaves
Comet Lavender growing: a clump of slim stems with closed pale lilac spikes
Comet Lavender in full bloom: a clump of curved lavender spikes in deep lilac, each spike tip pale silver-white and curling like a little comet tail
Comet Lavender wilted

sheets.title: Mẫu Đơn Pha Lê + Sen Mây

cells.desc: Crystal Peony sprout with two deeply cut green leaves
Crystal Peony growing: a leafy bush with one round tight pink bud
Crystal Peony in full bloom: one big ruffled peony in pale pink whose outer petals look like faceted translucent rose-quartz crystal, soft white highlights
Crystal Peony wilted, a few crystal petals fallen

Sky Lotus growing: two round lotus leaves and a pointed closed pink-white bud on a tall stem
